 council ~/code/telltale                                                                      no turn yet  │  3/3 seated
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 council — one brief, several agents, side by side                                                                      
                                                                                                                        
   i / enter    compose a brief                                                                                         
   enter        dispatch to every seated vendor                                                                         
   esc          leave compose (the draft is kept)                                                                       
   tab          move focus between columns                                                                              
   ctrl+c       cancel the turn in flight, or quit when idle                                                            
   q            quit (in view mode only — in compose it is the letter q)                                                
   ?            this help                                                                                               
                                                                                                                        
   council dispatches to vendor CLIs. It is the one telltale mode that                                                  
   does, and each column states its own read-only posture rather than                                                   
   the room making one claim on behalf of all three.

 VIEW                                                                     tab focus  │  i compose  │  ? help  │  q quit
